scenes.headline: How Kolibri runs a 78B model on 3.46B per token
scenes.sub: Aleph Alpha's open MoE, and how it stretches to 1M tokens.
scenes.say: Hi, I'm Lugnut! This open model stores seventy-eight billion parameters, runs about three and a half billion per token, and reads up to a million tokens.

scenes.text: Most of the model is experts a token never touches, and positions live only where distances are short.
scenes.mark: positions live only where distances are short
scenes.say: Most of the model is experts a token never touches. And positions live only where distances are short.

steps.say: The router scores every expert and keeps the top six.
Each layer has three hundred and eighty-four small experts. Only six run.
One shared expert always runs, and the outputs add up.

steps.note: 96.7% of the model is routed experts
steps.say: Almost the whole model lives in those routed experts.

scenes.label: of the parameters are active for each token
scenes.say: So a token uses four point four percent of the parameters. About half of that work is attention.

steps.label: 40 window blocks, with RoPE
steps.say: Forty blocks look back only five hundred and twelve tokens. They carry rotary positions, but never see a longer distance.

steps.label: 10 full blocks, no positions
steps.say: Every fifth block sees everything, with no positions at all. Nothing to extrapolate.
So a model trained at a quarter million tokens runs at a million.

scenes.title: KV cache at 1M tokens, FP8
scenes.say: At a million tokens the cache is about eleven gigabytes, against fifty-four if every block were full.

scenes.title: How the training scaled
scenes.say: The recipe came from a smaller predecessor.

items.say: Sweep everything on sixteen GPUs, where runs are cheap.
Grow sharding while compute still hides communication.
Add data-parallel replicas. Only six percent is lost.
The full model then split its experts across each node's eight GPUs.

scenes.text: Cheap long context comes from putting positions only in short windows and keeping few blocks that see everything.
scenes.say: Put positions only in short windows, and keep a few blocks that see everything.

recap: Window blocks with RoPE, full blocks without
scenes.say: Many experts, few active. Positions only in the windows. A million tokens, small cache.
